headline: Approved a letter inviting public comment on the Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan.
summary: Members discussed a draft letter that Michael Gagas prepared with staff support. They recommended several changes before voting.
decisions: Approved the letter inviting public comment on the Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan, as amended, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion to approve the letter as amended was made by Tom Routliffe. The motion was seconded by Kirk Brown. Upon a vote by all members present, the motion was approved unanimously.

decision_titles: Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan comment letter
plain_text:
Town of South Kingstown   
Economic Development Commission   
Special Meeting Minutes 
Monday, August 17, 2026 at 5:00 PM   
Town Hall - Planning Department 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Michael Gagas, Chair 
Randy Apuzzo, Vice Chair 
Thomas Routliffe 
Ken Tetzner 
Susan Marcus 
Ian Clark 
Jack Cadman 
Kirk Brown 
Gerry Schaffert 
Ibrahim Fofanah 
-- vacancy --  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
The meeting was called to order at: 05:08 PM 
Members Present:  Michael Gagas, Kirk Brown, Susan Marcus, Tom Routliffe, Ken Tetzner, Gerry Schaffert, 
Ibrahim Fofanah 
Members Absent:  Randy Apuzzo, Andrew Holt, Jack Cadman, Ian Clark 
Staff:  Brian Wagner 
B. New Business: 
 1. Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan - Discussion and action on letter inviting public comment on the 
plan, 
Members discussed the draft letter prepared by Mr. Gagas with support from staff and recommended several changes. 
A motion to approve the letter as amended was made by Tom Routliffe. The motion was seconded by Kirk Brown. Upon 
a vote by all members present, the motion was approved unanimously. 
C. Staff Update & Planning Department Activities: 
None. 
D. New Discussion Issues & Future Agenda Items: 
None. 
E. Adjournment: 
A motion was made to adjourn the meeting by Tom Routliffe. The motion was seconded by Kirk Brown and the meeting 
adjourned by unanimous consent at 05:40 PM.
